_comment: Copy to pipeline.config.json (gitignored) and edit for this machine. Every key can also be set as an environment variable: comfy_root -> PANELFORGE_COMFY_ROOT, and so on. Only comfy_root is required.
_paths: Use forward slashes even on Windows. They work in both the Python and PowerShell launchers, and they avoid JSON's backslash escaping (C:\\dir, not C:\dir).
_urls: Optional. Defaults shown; change only if you run these elsewhere.
_model: Optional. The Ollama vision model used for panel direction.
_cloud_director: Optional, only used with --director cloud (see cloud_director.py). The API key itself is never read from this file -- set it as an environment variable named for the provider (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), never committed anywhere.
_meme_font: Optional. Path to a .ttf for meme captions. Defaults to Windows' bundled Impact font if present.
_meme_intake_port: Optional. Port for meme_intake/server.py. Defaults shown.
_meme_projects_root: Optional. Directory containing meme project folders for meme_intake/server.py. Defaults to the current directory.
